answer_1.quote: In this work, we focus on a special kind of human-computer empathetic conversation, i.e., emotional support conversation... our model MISC produces supportive responses...
answer_1.outputs: empathetic responses in emotional support conversations

answer_2.quote: We adopt a set of automatic... metrics to assess the model performances: Automatic Metrics. (1) We take the strategy prediction accuracy ACC... (2) ...PPL (perplexity), B-2 (BLEU-2), B-4 (BLEU-4), R-L (ROUGE-L) and M (Meteor)... (3) For response diversity, we report D-1 (Distinct-1) and D-2 (Distinct-2)...

answer_4.quote: Following See et al. ( ), we also recruit 3 professional annotators... and ask them to rate the generated responses according to Fluency, Knowledge and Empathy aspects...
answer_4.guideline: Rate responses on Fluency, Knowledge, and Empathy using levels {0,1,2}
